style: Say firmly but kindly, like a ship captain giving clear directions
lines: Read the line and its notes. When the script says someone enters, drag them in from their wing.
Drag an actor from a wing onto the stage. Then pick the speaker and type their line under Beats.
Tap Next beat to block the next line.
Someone is upstaged. Bring the partner down, or turn the speaker out to the house.
Someone is hidden from a seat. Move them, or move whoever is in the way.
This is what one seat sees. Tap another seat to sit somewhere else.
Tap Run to watch the whole scene from your seat.
Places, please. House to half. Go.
Every note is met. That's a show.
That's the run. Some notes need work. Tap a note to jump to its beat.
That's your scene. Tap a beat in Block to change it, or Run again.
This is the last beat. Tap Run at the top to watch the whole scene from your seat.
Tap Add beat under Beats for another line, or tap Run at the top to watch your scene.
The scene is running. Watch from your seat, or tap Stop.
